events.title: Demo Update: Boat & Teleport Tutorials, Bug Fixes
events.summary: Hello, this is the developer of TBF: Task Bar Fishing. A small update has been applied to the TBF: Task Bar Fishing demo. New Tutorials We added guidance to the two spots where new players got stuck most often. Boat tutorial added - Walks you through the boat status, how upgrades work, and how to load your catch onto the boat, step by step. Teleport tutorial added - Explains the requirements and how to travel, right at the moment teleporting first becomes available. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46270043/5

events.title: TBF: Task Bar Fishing Demo Out Now!
events.summary: Hello! We're the developer behind TBF: Task Bar Fishing.The demo is finally here! A girl fishes away on her own in the corner of your taskbar, and you step in only at the important moments to gather resources and uncover the secrets of a drowned world one by one. It's a small adventure that keeps going in a corner of your desktop while you get on with everything else.What you can enjoy in the demo 3 fishing areas and their story! (10+ more areas planned) Over 70 catchable items - we're planning
